statistic.title: Répartition par type
statistic.sql: select ca_l_i.item_value as "Type", count(*) as "Nombre" from ca_loans ca_lo left join ca_list_items ca_l_i on ca_lo.type_id=ca_l_i.item_id and ca_l_i.parent_id is not null left join ca_lists ca_l on ca_l.list_id=ca_l_i.list_id group by ca_l_i.item_id order by 2 desc

statistic.title: Créations de prêts par mois cette année
statistic.sql: SELECT year(FROM_UNIXTIME(cal.log_datetime)) AS année, monthname(FROM_UNIXTIME(cal.log_datetime)) as mois, concat(count(DISTINCT logged_row_id)) as création FROM `ca_change_log` cal where cal.logged_table_num=133 and changetype="I" and year(NOW()) = year(FROM_UNIXTIME(cal.log_datetime)) GROUP BY année,mois ORDER BY année,month(FROM_UNIXTIME(cal.log_datetime))

statistic.title: Créations de prêts par mois - année précédente
statistic.sql: SELECT year(FROM_UNIXTIME(cal.log_datetime)) AS année, monthname(FROM_UNIXTIME(cal.log_datetime)) as mois, concat(count(DISTINCT logged_row_id)) as création FROM `ca_change_log` cal where cal.logged_table_num=133 and changetype="I" and year(NOW()) - 1 = year(FROM_UNIXTIME(cal.log_datetime)) GROUP BY année,mois ORDER BY année,month(FROM_UNIXTIME(cal.log_datetime))

statistic.title: Prêts par statut
statistic.sql: SELECT ca_li.idno as statut, count(loan_id) as nombre FROM ca_loans LEFT JOIN ca_list_items ca_li ON ca_li.item_value = status LEFT JOIN ca_lists ca_l ON ca_li.list_id=ca_l.list_id WHERE ca_l.list_code='workflow_statuses' and ca_li.item_value!="Root" group by ca_li.item_value

statistic.title: Prêts par accès
statistic.sql: SELECT ca_li.idno as accès, count(loan_id) as nombre FROM ca_loans LEFT JOIN ca_list_items ca_li ON ca_li.item_value = access LEFT JOIN ca_lists ca_l ON ca_li.list_id=ca_l.list_id WHERE ca_l.list_code='access_statuses' and ca_li.item_value!="Root" group by ca_li.item_value

statistic.title: Prêts supprimés
statistic.sql: SELECT IF(deleted>0,"yes","no") as "Supprimé", count(loan_id) as Nombre FROM ca_loans GROUP BY deleted
